## Symantec Threat Intelligence API (SES Complete)

Symantec introduced a Threat Intelligence API delivered through Symantec Endpoint Security Complete (SESC). The API provides real-time information on any file hash, domain, or IP address. That includes reputation, threat name, prevalence, age, industry, geography, and related indicators.

The API taps into Symantec's Global Intelligence Network. This new Threat Intelligence API, available through Symantec Endpoint Security Complete (SESC), jumpstarts the process, putting Symantec's Global Intelligence Network at your fingertips – on a platform you probably already use.

**Integration and availability:**
- The API has been integrated with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR) and Threat Intelligence Platform (TIP) partners ThreatQuotient, Anomali, and Siemplify. It's also available directly through Symantec's Integrated Cyber Defence Manager (ICDm) cloud platform.
- Buying the new API is easy – it's part of the SES Complete package. No separate purchase is required.

**Scale of intelligence:** The information is correlated from 175,000,000 endpoints and 126,000,000 attack sensors, tracking more than 25,000 ongoing network vulnerabilities.

## File Reputation (Symantec Insight)

Symantec collects information about files from its global community of millions of users and its Global Intelligence Network. The collected information is available to Symantec products in the cloud through Symantec Insight. Symantec Insight provides a file reputation database and the latest virus and spyware definitions. Symantec products leverage Insight to protect client computers from new, targeted, and mutating threats.

Insight assigns each file a reputation score. File reputation analysis (Insight) is based on the artificial intelligence that uses Symantec's global intelligence network. This advanced analysis examines billions of correlated linkages from users, websites, and files to identify and defend against rapidly mutating malware. By analyzing key attributes (such as the origin point of a file download), Symantec can accurately identify whether a file is good or bad and assign a reputation score all before the file arrives on the client computer.

The reputation lookups support multiple detection engines. Download Insight, behavioral analysis (SONAR), and virus and spyware scans use Insight lookups for threat detection. Symantec recommends that you always allow Insight lookups. Disabling lookups disables Download Insight and impairs the functionality of SONAR heuristics (14.3 RU4 and earlier only) and virus and spyware scans.

## Network Protection (Intrusion Prevention)

IPS blocks malware at the network layer before the payload arrives on the endpoint, as it scans both inbound and outbound network traffic. IPS is able to recognize and understand various network protocols and provide custom protection for each type, use pattern matching to identify unknown and known threats, and block command-and-control (C&C) communications to known malicious URLs and IP addresses using Symantec's Insight Intelligence.

IPS detects ransomware attacks by using URL reputation, which prevents web threats. IPS is a one-of-a-kind protection that no other security company uses.

## CVE / Vulnerability & Adversary Intelligence (DeepSight)

Symantec's DeepSight Intelligence platform offers deeper vulnerability and adversary context. Available for both emerging and historic threats, DeepSight vulnerability intelligence includes a rich set of contextual attributes including risk scores, impacted products, patch availability and exploits, among others.

For file-level intelligence tied to threat actors: DeepSight provides file reputation intelligence for billions of files that have been observed by its global information network, helping analysts accelerate investigations as well as connect the dots with other malicious indicators, such as campaigns or attackers.

On adversary attribution: DeepSight Intelligence data is enriched, verified and analyzed to provide attribution and to connect seemingly disparate indicators into campaigns with known actors and motivations behind them. The finished intelligence product is actionable and is made available via a web portal, datafeeds or restful APIs.
